'This gets +1{p} for each blue card you've pitched this turn.' Mystic Action - Attack.

ABILITY TYPE SET BY RELEASE NOTES: note 1 says the bonus keeps accruing for blue cards pitched AFTER the card resolves onto the combat chain - an always-checking condition (the Aggressive Pounce lesson), so this is a WHILE_STATIC re-evaluated on every RECALC_ATTACK_POWER dispatch, NOT a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK pump that would freeze the count at declaration. Recalculations happen at attack declaration, after reactions, and at the top of damage resolution, so a blue pitch any time before the damage step is counted there; no recalc happens after the damage step, which is release note 3's no-retroactivity falling out of engine timing. Shape is shipped pen/savage_claw.json (the documented pitch-conditioned static), with SOURCE_IS_ATTACK scoping the buff to this card's own attack.

AMOUNT IS A COUNT, NOT A GATE: amount expression {"type": "COUNT_TURN_EVENT", "event": "pitch", "qualifier": "blue"} resolves through _resolve_amount inside MODIFY_ATTACK (effect_types.py:4129 -> :101-115), counting did_this_turn:pitch:blue markers in the controller's current_turn_effects. This is exactly the fix .review/wide_blue_yonder_blue.json demanded for the IDENTICAL printed text on that card ('flat amount:1 gated on boolean EVENT_THIS_TURN ... undercounts every state with 2+ blue pitches'). The EVENT_THIS_TURN condition alongside it is belt-and-braces so a zero-count state registers no +0 mod at all.

PRODUCER VERIFIED: pitch() records the turn event with the card COLOUR as qualifier - effect_keywords.py:2714-2723 (_PITCH_COLOUR maps 1/2/3 to red/yellow/blue) - so the 'blue' qualifier matches. Release note 2 falls out by construction: the marker persists in current_turn_effects regardless of what later happens to the pitched card (e.g. Potion of Deja Vu removing it from the pitch zone).
